rationale: The papers [2310.03245] and [2506.16232] provide new evidence on the atmospheric composition of HD 209458b, confirming a low C/O ratio and no evidence of CH4, which addresses the tension regarding methane abundance. Paper [2204.04103] links atmospheric chemistry to formation location, supporting the explanation of observed abundances. Together, these findings resolve the question by confirming the low methane abundance and providing context for its atmospheric chemistry.
